$comment: Parent-org policies for boop's receipt signer (#286 P3): a second API-only user, separate from the auth relay's user in boop-api-user-policies.json, whose only power is to sign with the Boop service DID's receipt key. UNVALIDATED: none of these has been submitted to the live Turnkey API. See docs/service-did.md before applying. Replace <BOOP_RECEIPT_SIGNER_USER_ID> with that user's userId, and <RECEIPT_KEY_ADDRESS> / <UPDATE_KEY_ADDRESS> with the Solana-format addresses `bun scripts/boop-service-did.ts show` and Turnkey report. Turnkey denies by default, and an EFFECT_DENY overrides every allow. After a rotation, replace <RECEIPT_KEY_ADDRESS> with the new key's address.

policies.policyName: boop-receipt-signer: allow signing with the receipt key
policies.notes: The only activity convex/lib/serviceReceipts.ts submits. The wallet_account.address term is the least certain part of this file: if Turnkey rejects it, scope by wallet.id to a wallet that holds only the receipt key, and keep the update key in another wallet.
The update key signs DID log entries. Whoever can sign with it can replace the receipt key, so Convex must never be able to.

policies.policyName: boop-receipt-signer: deny everything else it could be used for
policies.notes: Belt and braces: the allow policy already excludes these. This user takes no part in sign-in, creates no keys and exports nothing. The resource names are the least certain part; if Turnkey rejects one, drop that term, not the policy.
